description: Project scaffolding - Initialize Next.js 14 App Router project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Prisma with SQLite, Zustand, Recharts, Lucide React, and Poppins font. Configure brand colors and theming.
steps: Initialize Next.js 14 project with TypeScript and App Router using create-next-app in the /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform directory (use --use-pnpm flag, app router, tailwind, src directory, import alias @/*)
Install additional dependencies: prisma, @prisma/client, zustand, recharts, lucide-react, @hello-pangea/dnd (for drag-and-drop kanban)
Initialize shadcn/ui with pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init (use default style, zinc as base color, CSS variables enabled)
Add shadcn/ui components needed: button, card, badge, input, select, dialog, tabs, avatar, dropdown-menu, sheet, separator, scroll-area, tooltip

Configure Tailwind CSS with Propela brand colors in tailwind.config.ts: propela-purple (#5B2D8E), propela-purple-dark (#3D1D5E), propela-purple-light (#F3EDF9), propela-purple-mid (#7B4BAE). Add action colors: overdue (#EF4444), due-today (#F59E0B), upcoming (#0D9488), no-action (#9CA3AF). Add readiness colors: not-ready (#6B7280), placement-ready (#10B981), placed (#5B2D8E), dropped-out-bg (#FEE2E2), deferred-bg (#FEF9C3), flag-red (#DC2626).
Configure Poppins font via next/font/google in the root layout (weights 400, 500, 600, 700)
Set up Prisma with SQLite provider - create prisma/schema.prisma with datasource pointing to file:./dev.db
Create a basic app layout in src/app/layout.tsx with the Poppins font applied globally and a sidebar navigation shell
Create src/app/page.tsx that redirects to /nurses (the Nurse Database module)
acceptance_criteria: pnpm dev starts the development server
Tailwind CSS is working with custom Propela brand colors available
Poppins font is loaded and applied globally
Prisma schema exists with SQLite provider configured
shadcn/ui components are initialized and importable
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm it exits with code 0
Run pnpm lint and confirm no errors
findings: 1. Google Fonts API (fonts.googleapis.com) is inaccessible in COMMON_DEPENDENCIES mode. Used @fontsource/poppins npm package instead to bundle Poppins font locally. 2. Prisma binary engine downloads from binaries.prisma.sh are blocked (403). prisma generate will need to be run when network access is available or in CI. The schema and configuration are correct. 3. Build and lint both pass successfully without prisma generate.
